conf.comment:
cisco_esa to OCSF pipeline.
Parses events, drops noise, maps to OCSF schema, and outputs compact JSON.

functions.description: Extract ESA log header (timestamp, level, message body)
Extract message/connection identifiers (MID, ICID, DCID, RID)
Parse new inbound SMTP connection (sender IP + reverse DNS)

functions.filter: msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('interim verdict') >= 0 || msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('using engine') >= 0

functions.description: Parse DKIM verification result and domain

add.name: action
add.value: msg_body && (msg_body.indexOf('queued for delivery') >= 0 || msg_body.indexOf('Message done') >= 0) ? 'delivered' : msg_body && (msg_body.indexOf('Dropped') >= 0 || msg_body.indexOf('aborted') >= 0) ? 'dropped' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('quarantine') >= 0 ? 'quarantined' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('Bounced') >= 0 ? 'bounced' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('TLS') >= 0 ? 'allowed' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('DKIM') >= 0 ? 'allowed' : 'received'

add.name: category
add.value: msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('quarantine') >= 0 ? 'phishing' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('TLS') >= 0 ? 'tls' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('DKIM') >= 0 ? 'dkim' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('spam') >= 0 ? 'spam' : msg_body && msg_body.indexOf('antivirus') >= 0 ? 'malware' : 'email'

functions.description: Classify ESA event action and category from message body

add.name: severity
add.value: level == 'Critical' ? 'critical' : level == 'Warning' ? 'medium' : level == 'Info' ? 'informational' : level == 'Debug' ? 'low' : undefined

add.name: message_id
add.value: mid || undefined

add.name: session_id
add.value: dcid || icid || undefined

add.name: src_user
add.value: sender || undefined

add.name: user
add.value: sender || undefined

add.name: dest_user
add.value: recipient || undefined

add.name: subject
add.value: subject || undefined

add.name: app
add.value: 'Cisco ESA'

add.name: vendor_product
add.value: 'Cisco Email Security Appliance'

add.name: signature
add.value: filter_rule || av_name || undefined

add.name: src
add.value: src_ip || tls_peer_cn || undefined

add.name: host
add.value: 'cisco-esa'

functions.description: Alias ESA fields to CIM Email canonical names

Golden OCSF mapping — deterministic from canonical fields (no AI).
